Aspera Connect — employee downloads
===================================

PHONE (Google Play Internal testing)
  https://play.google.com/apps/internaltest/4701460117553190758

  Phone must be signed into an allow-listed Google account:
  cashaameet@gmail.com
  gadaramchandra@gmail.com
  marketing@thegstco.com
  priyanka@thegstco.com
  ramchandragada@gmail.com
  thegstco9@gmail.com

  Steps on phone:
  1. Sign in to that Google account
  2. Open join link → Become a tester
  3. Install Aspera Connect from Play
  4. Start for calls → Scan PC QR

PC
  https://github.com/ramchandragada/asperaconnect/raw/cursor/phone-contacts-sync-5b4f/dist/release/AsperaConnect-Desktop.deb

Pair: PC Show QR → Phone Scan PC QR
